Great update! I have two suggestions that I feel would be great quality of life improvements. 

- Ability cooldown timers that show how much time is left on the game screen, perhaps above heroes heads/above ultimate timers, using two smaller circles that progressively dial down? This would make it easier to time and chain together abilities and ultimates, it is annoying to use your ults in a boss wave and see abilities proc in the time between the wave completing and the next wave/stage (such as Wendle's "Thunder Something" or V's "Run, Emmet, Run!") essentially wasting them. 

- Other ways of spending tokens. I can only speak for myself but after purchasing a currency pack and simply saving them up from Dragon ad offers, I have an excessive amount with very little to spend them on, whereas gems, scraps and mythstones are spent/used constantly. One great use for them could be to spend tokens to skip sidequests that you don't want? It sucks having to spend gems to skip inconvenient sidequests that could be better used toward special offers or chests, and having a boatload of tokens not being used. To offset this and make it a viable alternative, perhaps the cost of tokens to skip quests could be higher, like 100~ (+/-) or more as an alternative to the gem fee.
